title: x402 seller metrics v0.1
description: Honest per-seller reporting standard for x402 services. Published at /.well-known/x402-metrics.json. All counts are for the declared window unless a field says otherwise.

spec_version.description: REQUIRED. Version of this spec the document conforms to.

generated_at.description: REQUIRED. ISO 8601 timestamp when this report was generated. Maps Utilia generatedAt.

name.description: REQUIRED. Seller name as listed publicly.

url.description: OPTIONAL. Seller site or listing URL.

protocol.description: REQUIRED. Payment protocol and version, e.g. "x402/v2".

window.description: REQUIRED. The reporting window. Explicit start and end, no assumed period. Monthly is the recommended cadence but any window is valid if declared.

end.description: REQUIRED. Window end, exclusive, ISO 8601. Must be after start.

hours.description: REQUIRED. Window duration in hours. Must equal (end - start). Maps Utilia windowHours.

endpoints.description: REQUIRED. One row per paid endpoint. An array, never a map keyed by URL, so aggregation across sellers is trivial.

declared_exclusions.description: REQUIRED, may be empty. Wallets the seller controls or has arrangements with, declared by address. Payments from these addresses are excluded from unique_payers, repeat_payers, and revenue_usdc_net_of_own_wallets, and are classified by source_class in the breakdowns. An empty array is a positive claim: no such wallets exist.

notes.description: OPTIONAL. Free text: methodology caveats, price history, anything a reader needs to interpret the numbers honestly.

extensions.description: OPTIONAL. Namespaced extra data. Anything not in the core spec goes here, never as new top-level fields.

source_class.description: organic: a real outside buyer consuming the output. verifier: pays to confirm the endpoint works, not to consume the output (registry crawlers settling to confirm liveness, directory validators, health checks, probes). prearranged: known integration or fixture wallet, payment agreed in advance. self: a wallet the seller controls. scanner: automated discovery traffic, typically hits challenges but rarely pays. unknown: the seller could not classify with confidence. unknown is legitimate, not a failure state.

source_class_breakdown.description: Counts by source_class. All six keys required so zeros are explicit and aggregation is trivial. Must sum to the metric it breaks down.

abandonment_causes.description: Counts of abandoned challenges by cause. funding: buyer wallet empty or unfunded. policy: spend limit, allowlist, or human-approval gate blocked the payment. retry_handling: the buyer runtime could not construct or send the signed retry. receipt_handling: it paid or could have paid but could not process what came back. unknown: no evidence either way, the honest default. All keys required so zeros are explicit.

paid_retry_failures.description: REQUIRED. Counts the case where a buyer paid, retried with the payment signature, and still did not get what they paid for. by_class must sum to total. Maps Utilia paidRetryFailuresByClass.

by_class.description: One entry per failure class observed. Empty array when total is 0. No duplicate classes.

note.description: REQUIRED when class is "other", so other cannot become a dumping ground. OPTIONAL for every other class.

challenges_served.description: REQUIRED. Number of 402 challenge responses served in the window. Maps Utilia challenges.

paid_calls.description: REQUIRED. Number of calls with a settled payment in the window, all sources included. Maps Utilia settlements.

challenges_abandoned.description: REQUIRED, nullable. Challenges served that never produced a payment attempt: no retry carrying a payment signature was observed from that client within the window. This is the largest drop-off on the rail and the least published. If you cannot attribute retries to challenges, report null. Never guess.

payment_attempts.description: OPTIONAL. Retries that arrived carrying a payment signature, whether or not they settled or delivered. The middle of the funnel: challenges_served minus payment_attempts approximates abandonment, payment_attempts minus paid_calls approximates failure. Maps Utilia paidRetryAttempts.

abandonment_causes.description: OPTIONAL. Best-effort split of challenges_abandoned by cause, where the seller has evidence. unknown is the default, not a guess. Must sum to challenges_abandoned when that value is non-null.

unique_payers.description: REQUIRED. Distinct payer wallets in the window, EXCLUDING every address in declared_exclusions. Maps Utilia uniquePayerWallets.

repeat_payers.description: REQUIRED. Distinct non-excluded wallets with settled paid calls on at least 2 DISTINCT UTC CALENDAR DAYS within the window. Distinct days, not distinct calls: a wallet paying 50 times in one day counts 0 here. Must be <= unique_payers.

revenue_usdc_net_of_own_wallets.description: REQUIRED. Settled USDC revenue in the window, excluding payments from addresses with source_class "self" in declared_exclusions. Payments from prearranged or verifier wallets are real revenue and stay in, the breakdowns reveal them. Maps Utilia revenueUsdc.

paid_calls_by_source_class.description: paid_calls split by source_class. Must sum to paid_calls. REQUIRED in totals, OPTIONAL per endpoint. Maps Utilia integrationSource.

challenges_by_source_class.description: OPTIONAL. challenges_served split by source_class. Must sum to challenges_served. Report it if you can: the distribution usually differs sharply from the paid distribution, and that difference is itself the finding.

route.description: REQUIRED. Endpoint path, e.g. "/api/verify". Maps Utilia route.

method.description: OPTIONAL. HTTP method, defaults to POST.

price_usdc.description: OPTIONAL. Current price per call in USDC. Informational: prices change, revenue is normative.

totals_block.description: REQUIRED. Seller-level totals across all endpoints. Additive fields must equal the sum of endpoint rows. unique_payers and repeat_payers are deduplicated across endpoints, so each must be between the max of the endpoint values and their sum.

source_class.description: REQUIRED. Why this wallet is excluded. organic and unknown are not valid here: you cannot exclude what you claim not to know.

evidence.description: REQUIRED. How a third party can confirm the classification: a public doc, a repo, an announcement, or a plain statement of ownership.

label.description: OPTIONAL. Human-readable name for the wallet.

receipt_linkage.description: REQUIRED. Enough on-chain pointers that a third party can independently reconstruct the revenue claim. At least one of settlement_tx_hashes or block_range must be present. Maps Utilia receiptLinkage.

chain.description: REQUIRED. CAIP-2 chain id, e.g. "eip155:8453" for Base.

asset.description: REQUIRED. Asset contract address, e.g. the USDC contract on the declared chain.

settlement_tx_hashes.description: List of settlement transaction hashes in the window. Expected when paid_calls is small (100 or fewer). See README for why this is not always required.

block_range.description: Block range covering the window, for auditors to scan transfers to the receiving address.
